storage: Keep unwashed in a paper-lined bag in the fridge; trim and wash just before cooking.
looksLike: Slim, straight, bright-green pods 10 to 15 cm long with small seeds inside, snapping crisply when fresh.
howToPick: Slim, bright-green pods that snap cleanly with no rust spots or limp ends. Avoid bulging, tough, yellowing pods.
shelfLife: About 4 to 5 days in the fridge (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
